title: Midtown South NYC Architecture Walking Tour
includes: In person guide in English, Spanish and Italian
Professional Individual Headsets for Each Guest
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: The travel time is included in the tour duration.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Situated at the heart of New York City, Midtown and its surrounding neighborhoods are the dynamic epicenter of the metropolis. This locality’s frenetic energy finds physical translation in the dazzling lights of Time Square and the ascendant skyscrapers of the business district. During this Midtown Manhattan Architecture Tour, we will chart the history of Midtown through its architecture, starting with examples from the early twentieth century and culminating with the latest additions to this area’s urban landscape.
